text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer brought Sakura Laurel along to 
watch the Japanese Derby. Even if it was 
painful, it was to show her Narita Brian's 
run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As the race began, Sakura Laurel was 
captivated by Narita Brian's immense 
strength. She was so powerful, so 
dazzlingly bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian conquered the Japanese Derby. 
Sakura Laurel felt a fierce desire to 
defeat her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian will surely grow even 
stronger. In fact, she wants her to get 
stronger. Strong enough that no one can 
beat her in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Because a chance to defeat Narita Brian 
would open up for her too. Sakura Laurel 
begins taking straight strides toward the 
one she admires.
